summary_en: ¥45.0M upper limit, 50,000 shares (0.7% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥900/share ceiling, execution window Jun 22–Nov 12, 2026, ToSTNeT-3 (open-market) method.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, the board of Commerce One Holdings Inc. (ticker 4496, Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth) authorized a treasury share acquisition under the Companies Act (Art. 165(3), read in conjunction with Art. 156). The company will acquire up to 50,000 common shares (0.7% of shares outstanding, calculated as 50,000 ÷ 6,949,451 ex-treasury shares) for an aggregate maximum of ¥45.0 million (implying a price ceiling of ¥900 per share). Execution is via open-market purchase under a discretionary trading agreement (ToSTNeT-3), scheduled from 22 June 2026 to 12 November 2026. The acquisition is framed as part of strategic financial management, taking into account investment opportunities, financial position, and market price levels. As of the filing date, the company held 243,949 treasury shares.
